title: A Terrified Teacher at Ghoul School!
titleEnglish: A Terrified Teacher at Ghoul School!
titleNative: 妖怪学校の先生はじめました!
synonyms: I Started Being a Teacher for a Youkai School!
synopsis: Rookie teacher Haruaki Abe is as cowardly as they come. It's hard enough for him to handle human students without whimpering-and now he's going to be teaching at a school full of monsters?! It's a classroom of horrors for Haruaki, as his mischievous students use every means at their disposal to prank him! Will this poor teacher be able to get his group of ghouls under control, or is this class destined for failure? (Source: Yen Press)

titleNative: 世界で一番『可愛い』雨宮さん、二番目は俺
synonyms: The World's Most 'Cutest' is Amamiya-san, and the Second is Me.
synopsis: Hikari is a popular model nicknamed the “Cutest Girl in the World,” but behind that gorgeous female façade is an ordinary high school boy named Harema Kouki! Since his model self is so adorable, Kouki never really finds other girls cute…until one day, when he realizes his plain and boring classmate, Amamiya-san, is actually cuter than he is! A high school rom-com between an overconfident diva and a diamond in the rough! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Tenjiku Neppuuroku
synonyms: The Chronicle of the Scorching Winds of India
Chronicle of the Searing Winds of Tianzhu
synopsis: The manga tells a fictional version of the story of historical Tang China diplomat Wang Xuance, centering on his diplomatic journey from Tang Dynasty China to the Empire of Harsha in India in the 7th century CE. When he comes upon a crumbling empire that is now hostile to him he escapes to Tibet and raises a confederation of Tang, Nepalese, and Tibetan soldiers to mount a raid on the Empire of Harsha. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Tensei Shitara Suterareta ga, Hirowarete Tanoshiku Ikiteimasu
titleRomaji: Tensei Shitara Suterareta ga, Hirowarete Tanoshiku Ikiteimasu
titleNative: 転生したら捨てられたが、拾われて楽しく生きています。
synonyms: When she was reincarnated, she was abandoned, but she was picked up and is living happily ever after
synopsis: Millie is reincarnated as a baby with memories of her previous life.However, at the age of five months, she is abandoned in the cold...! She was picked up by Joe and Marissa who happened to be passing by, and her life was saved, but the life of the common people in another world that awaits her is quite severe.... She finds herself in a dirty room full of dust and stains, without the delicious food she had in her previous life! The couple's restaurant and inn, "Cat's Pavilion in the Shade of the Trees," is in financial trouble! In order to return the favor she was given, she changes the store with her cheat magic and knowledge from her previous life...the long-awaited comic book version of the popular web novel!

title: MAKE A GIRL
synopsis: High school student Akira Mizutane, whose mother is a genius scientist, spends his days trying to follow in his mother's footsteps. However, he feels that he has reached a dead end in his research and becomes depressed, thinking that he doesn't have the talent his mother has. One day, Akira is advised by a friend that a man can become more powerful by having a girlfriend, so he creates an artificial human girlfriend, "No. 0". (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Hellper 2: Killberos
synopsis: Jang Dae-Ho, the infamous vice president of the Nine Snake Family gang overthrown after 'the purge', was disposing of dead assassins bodies in the ruins of the grand earthquake that struck the forsaken city of Kana when he found a starved and nameless orphan. Taking him under his wing and giving him the name "Gwangnam" would be the catalyst for a long and bloody revenge journey under which the name "Killberos" began. Thus, this is the dark story of Gwangnam's crime infested upbringing, riddled with the many street rivalries and gangs' power struggles that preceded the formation of the fence project and "Killberos", the guard tribe, as we know it before his passing.

title: Hatsukoi no Katachi wa △
synopsis: Minato confessed to Tsukasa, his childhood friend but was turned down because she had always thought of him as more of a little brother. Devastated but not willing to give up, he went to consult Tooru, an extremely popular boy in his class for advice. To his surprise, after hearing about his failed confession, Tooru confessed to him that he is in fact his first love! The curtain now rises for Minato's unbelievable triangle relationship...

title: SHIORI EXPERIENCE: Jimi na Watashi to Hen na Ojisan
titleRomaji: SHIORI EXPERIENCE: Jimi na Watashi to Hen na Ojisan
titleNative: SHIORI EXPERIENCE ~ジミなわたしとヘンなおじさん~
synopsis: Shiori was once a guitarist in a light music club in high school, but her first live performance was dashed when her brother ran away from home with a lot of debt to become a musician in Tokyo. A decade later, Shiori is now a high school teacher, leading a boring, uneventful life and paying off the debt... till she runs into the ghost of none other than a famous guitarist Jim-you-know-who. A story of a 27-year-old woman on her way to a music legend begins here.

title: Dream Life: Yume no Isekai Seikatsu
titleRomaji: Dream Life: Yume no Isekai Seikatsu
titleNative: ドリーム・ライフ: 夢の異世界生活
synopsis: A middle-aged engineer who was weary of life ended up being reborn into a different world as Zack, the son of a frontier feudal lord. Once there, he received a mission from God. He was told to prepare himself for the task of “guiding the future hero of the world”. With that in mind, Zack not only trained himself in swordsmanship and magic but also committed himself towards reforming problems in hygiene and education. After developing a new local product, Zack was reminded of his once forgotten dream: brewing alcohol! As he resurrected his long lost passion, it was the beginning of his “Dream Life”.
